block_05_direct_answer.title: Direct answer
block_05_direct_answer.body_html: Service charges matter because they affect the ongoing cost of ownership. For a Dubai purchase, compare what the charges cover, how they are calculated, the building or community standard and material differences between alternatives. Use current project or building documents for the final figure rather than relying on a broad market assumption.

items.question: Are service charges important?

items.answer: Service charges should be checked because they directly affect the ongoing ownership cost. Break out service charges, cooling, utilities, management and other recurring costs instead of treating one headline figure as the full annual burden.
items.question: How do I verify service charges?

items.answer: Hidden costs are usually the expenses omitted from the headline property price. Include service charges, maintenance, utilities or management expenses that continue after completion and affect the real holding cost.
items.question: What hidden costs should I budget for?

items.answer: Total cost is broader than the advertised property price. Add service charges, maintenance, management and other expected holding costs when comparing the real economic burden of different options.
items.question: How do I compare total cost?

items.answer: The final purchase price can differ materially from the advertised property price. Important transaction or ownership expenses are missing from the comparison. Use current transaction-specific figures so a cheaper headline price does not hide a more expensive overall purchase.
